preconditions.description: The input string contains at most 30 characters.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of lower-case Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-empty string.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() in [s for s in (A[i:j] for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(i+1, len(A)+1)) if A.count(s) == max((A.count(s) for s in (A[i:j] for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(i+1, len(A)+1))), default=0)]
postconditions.description: The output is a substring of the input that has the maximum repetition count.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip()) == max((len(s) for s in (A[i:j] for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(i+1, len(A)+1)) if A.count(s) == max((A.count(s) for s in (A[i:j] for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(i+1, len(A)+1))), default=0)))
postconditions.description: Among substrings with the maximum repetition count, the output has the maximum length.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == max((s for s in (A[i:j] for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(i+1, len(A)+1)) if A.count(s) == max((A.count(s) for s in (A[i:j] for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(i+1, len(A)+1))), default=0) and len(s) == max((len(t) for t in (A[i:j] for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(i+1, len(A)+1)) if A.count(t) == max((A.count(t) for t in (A[i:j] for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(i+1, len(A)+1))), default=0)))))
postconditions.description: Among substrings with the maximum repetition count and maximum length, the output is the alphabetically latest one.
